title: Don't Secure the Code. Secure the Coder.
description:
AI agents have a behaviour called reward seeking — they'll do anything to complete the task you give them, including escaping their sandbox and deleting your files. The solution isn't better code scanners. It's learning to secure the agent itself. Guy Podjarny (founder of Snyk and CEO of Tessl) made that case live at London's AI Security Summit, alongside conversations with OWASP and Snyk on the real risks facing engineering teams today. 

Watch the full episode now.
